story_facts.fact: The menu centers on American comfort food; the restaurant serves brunch, lunch and dinner in Downtown Sacramento.
The private-events patio is 3,000 square feet with greenery, an overhead shade structure and two fire pits.
The official anniversary popup identifies Bacon Wrapped Meatloaf and Breakfast Waffle Sandwich as dishes from the earliest menus.
